איך לקרוא את המדידה

הציון משקלל את המדדים לפי המשקל המוגדר. מדד שחל על הקליפ וחסרים לו נתונים מקבל אפס נקודות; מדד שלא חל אינו נכלל. כיסוי המדידה מצוין בדף הקליפ. הוא שימושי לתיעדוף ולמציאת נסיגות; תנועה מכוונת ואסימטרית עשויה להיות תקינה. פרטי המגע והעמידה מגיעים ממטא־דאטה כשהוא זמין.

מדדשיטהתקרת ירוקתקרת צהוביחידה
החלקת רגלייםMaximum horizontal sole displacement from the first sample of each declared support window, divided by character height. Inferred support is used only when no windows were supplied.0.010.035height ratio
חדירה לרצפהMaximum depth of the supplied sole probe points and all skeletal joint centers below the declared floor plane, divided by height. Sole probes are not a mesh collision audit.0.0050.02height ratio
קפיצות פוזהMaximum adjacent 60 Hz-equivalent step: root-relative marker displacement / 0.04 height, root-relative rotation / 15 degrees, or root translation / 0.08 height. A fast continuous action can also exceed this screening threshold.12.5discontinuity ratio
חריגות אנטומיותPercentage of frames with elbow or knee flexion above 165 degrees, neck bend above 80 degrees, or a segment length changing by more than 5%. Optional calibrated hinge checks detect reverse knee flexion above 8 degrees. Conservative marker limits do not diagnose axial joint twist.0.53% affected frames
מגע בכדורMaximum absolute distance from the ball surface to the sampled, bone-transformed declared contact point, divided by height. Events are evaluated at their exact declared times by interpolation.0.0150.05height ratio
כניסה ויציאה מול המתנהWorst entry/exit mismatch to the best matching idle phase: RMS marker error / 0.04 height, RMS bone rotation / 25 degrees, or RMS endpoint velocity error / 0.75 height per second. Horizontal root translation is aligned; root height and body pose remain measurable.13continuity ratio
מהירות גוף מול צעדיםRelative difference between average root travel speed and the median backward support-foot sweep speed relative to the root. Cadence and implied stride lengths are also reported. In-place clips need an explicit reference travel scenario; stationary actions are not scored as locomotion.0.20.5relative speed error
סימטריהMaximum bilateral segment-length mismatch. Looping locomotion additionally compares reflected half-cycle leg markers; explicit pose symmetry compares simultaneous bilateral markers. One-sided actions retain unscored motion diagnostics, so a valid kick or dribble arm is not penalized for intentional asymmetry.0.030.1relative mismatch
